title: Pyramid sarcophagi too big for the entrance, so placed while the chamber was built

tellings.quote: And the sarcophagi are too big for the entrance way. So they're not brought in later. They were placed in the room while the room was created.

plain: A researcher named Luke Caverns told podcast host Jesse Michels that the stone coffins, or sarcophagi, inside the pyramids are too big to fit through the entrances. So, he says, they were not brought in later but were set in place while the rooms around them were being built. He uses this to argue the pyramids are not what most people think they are.
